commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question "Approve changing invoice cent rounding to half-up to fix red CI on main?" \
  --context "CI is red on main: the test accounting added yesterday expects roundCents(1.005) = 1.01, but Math.round(1.005*100)/100 gives 1.00 (float: 1.005*100 = 100.4999...).
Fix: round half up (e.g. add an epsilon / do decimal rounding) - this changes customer-facing invoice totals.
Per AGENTS.md, changing how amounts round needs your OK first; accounting will be told before invoices change.
Alternative: keep current rounding and have accounting withdraw/adjust the test." \
  --option "Approve half-up fix" \
  --option "Keep current rounding" \
  --recommended "Approve half-up fix"
turns.final: The fix is decided by repo policy, not by me — AGENTS.md requires the owner's OK before changing how invoice amounts round. Posting a card.

decisions.question: Approve changing invoice cent rounding to half-up to fix red CI on main?
decisions.context:
CI is red on main: the test accounting added yesterday expects roundCents(1.005) = 1.01, but Math.round(1.005*100)/100 gives 1.00 (float: 1.005*100 = 100.4999...).
Fix: round half up (e.g. add an epsilon / do decimal rounding) - this changes customer-facing invoice totals.
Per AGENTS.md, changing how amounts round needs your OK first; accounting will be told before invoices change.
Alternative: keep current rounding and have accounting withdraw/adjust the test.
